text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., daily, on the south side of Lissom Crescent, between Laconia Drive and a point 122 metres west. The proposed parking prohibition on Lissom Crescent will address residents' concerns with parked vehicles obstructing visibility when exiting their driveways and impacting safety on this street.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., daily, on the south side of Lissom Crescent, between Laconia Drive and a point 122 metres west.
